newsitem.title: USA: JPS Textile solicits for ok to restructure plan.
newsitem.headline: JPS Textile solicits for ok to restructure plan.

text.p: JPS Textile Group said Thursday it has began a solicitation for approval of its previously announced restructuring plan.

The restructuring plan is the product of an agreement in principal between the company and an unofficial committee of bondholder, representing more than 60 percent of the company's outstanding public debt.
Holders of the company's public securities must return their ballots no later than July 28 in order to vote.
Under the proposed plan, JPS Textile will convert 100 percent of its long-term debt to equity.
The restructuring will take place at the holding company level only and will not effect JPS Converter & Industrial Corp and JPS Elastomerics Corp.
The plan provides for the restructuring to be effected through a voluntary "prepackaged" Chapter 11 case, which the company would file shortly after July 28.
